hypothesis: Crypto return continuation flips with size: relatively large/liquid coins exhibit short-horizon momentum while relatively small but tradable coins exhibit short-horizon reversal. Combining the two opposite sleeves should diversify the same return-ranking signal.
universe: Point-in-time Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals. Each Monday first keep top 100 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume. Use the top liquidity quintile as the large proxy and bottom liquidity quintile within this tradable top-100 as the small proxy.
size_proxy_deviation: Historical point-in-time market capitalization is unavailable locally; lagged trailing quote volume is fixed ex ante as the size/trading-activity proxy.
signal: Prior completed F-day close-to-close return ending Sunday.
portfolio: Large sleeve: long top momentum tercile / short bottom tercile. Small sleeve: long recent-losers tercile / short recent-winners tercile. Each sleeve contributes 0.50 gross; combined gross target 1.0.
execution: Signal through Sunday close; rebalance Monday 00:00 UTC open; hold to next Monday open.
development_gate: Canonical large winner-minus-loser next-week spread >0, canonical small loser-minus-winner spread >0, canonical combined net Sharpe >0.70, and >=2/3 formation windows positive after costs.
success_gate: Canonical OOS combined net Sharpe >1.0, positive at 2x cost, >=2/3 formation windows positive, both 2024 and 2025 non-negative, max drawdown <35%, large and small sleeve OOS totals each positive, and excluding the strongest asset remains positive.
